title: Ordinary model cycles and raw pullback restriction
statement: For a scheme W [def-pc-scheme], an open U, and an integer complex K of module sheaves on the localized site over U [def-pc-derived-category], let A be the existing exact equivalence Modules.overEquiv U to modules on U. For maps t:T→W and s:T→U, define G_K(t,s) as the additive subgroup of Hom(t*O_W,s*A(K^0)) consisting of morphisms f with f followed by s*A(d_K^0)=0; tensor pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback]. For i:T′→T and equalities i;t=t′ and i;s=s′, define restriction of raw morphisms by the canonical composition comparisons, each obtained by conjugating the pushforward comparison under the pinned adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. It is c_t.hom followed by i*(f) followed by c_s.inv.

def picardOrdinaryModelCycles (W : Scheme.{v}) (U : W.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme) :
    AddSubgroup ((Modules.tensorPullback t).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) ⟶
        (Modules.tensorPullback s).obj ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (K.X 0)))
